title: siphonia elastica
intro: Siphonia elastica, commonly known as Bael tree, is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Siphonia elastica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Siphonia elastica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
